_meta.target: all trackerdata.json entries at any depth, matched on country + url
_meta.method: three sources. (a) kind=='journalism' -> media, or the name matched one unambiguous pattern. (b) kind=='institution' AND voice=='interpretive' -> ngo. (c) 5,275 entries read individually with their descriptions across 29 passes — the only route to 'council', 'conduct', 'index' and most of 'bar', none of which is reachable from a name.
_meta.caveat: name-only classification; every unmatched entry is left at the existing default 'other', which is legal and visible
